Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 22-Nov-2025 (02:00 PM - 05:00 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MANIPAL INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY - BENGALURU  
  FIRST SEMESTER M.TECH. EXAMINATIONS - NOVEMBER 2025  
  Digital CMOS IC Design [ECE_5151]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                      Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  PART-A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1)                For a Boolean logic given: Y = ( A + B.C.A' ) which has a drive strength of x16 at the output stage, (5)  
  Draw the CMOS transistor level circuit and size the transistors using logical effort method and stage  
  A)           ratios.  
  Note:  
  
  Do not apply any Boolean deduction methods to reduce the equation. Do it as is.  
  Consider Wpmos=2W and Wnmos=W to get equal pull-up and pull-down current in an  
  inverter while driving the same sized inverter.  
  Use Stage ratio as 1:4  
  A' should be generated as part of the circuit and transistors to be sized appropriately.  
  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  B)           For a Boolean logic given: Y = ( A + B.C' )' in which the C' is internally generated using signal C. (5)  
  Draw the CMOS transistor level circuit and respective Stick Diagram which is optimized to keep  
  minimum parasitic capacitances. Show the Euler's path used to arrive at the optimized drain/source  
  sharing and ensure to have least internal drain capacitance at node Y.  
  Note:  
  
  Do not apply any Boolean deduction methods to reduce the equation. Do it as is.  
  Use colour code as below for stick diagram  
  
  a. Power - VDD and VSS - Red  
  b. Poly - Green  
  c. Metal - Dark Blue  
  d. Oxide - Use Rectangle with Orange highlight  
  e. Contacts - Use 'X' in black  
  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
2)                Explain CMOS Twin Well Fabrication method using a Step by Step Approach to achieve a cross             (4)  
  section of CMOS Inverter. Explain the reason for N+ implant in Nwell and P+ implant in P-Well.  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
  B)           Explain Photo Lithography and different types of Photo-resists.                                        (2)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
  Page #1

C)   Draw the Cross section with proper terminal representations and connections of below circuit using (4)  
  Deep N-Well Process for CMOS Fabrication.  
  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
3)        Explain NMOS Operation with appropriate cross section images and respective equations for             (4)  
  different regions of operation and graphs of ( Ids Vs Vds with different Vgs ) and (Ids Vs Vgs for  
  A)   constant V ds )  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
  B)   Explain Voltage Transfer Characteristics of a CMOS Inverter with different regions of operation.      (4)  
  Consider the switching point of the ideal inverter is at VDD/2, if we increase the width of only PMOS  
  by keeping NMOS width constant, what happens to the switching point. Show it graphically.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  C)   Write the Truth Table and Explain the disadvantages of below circuit.                                 (2)  
  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
  Page #2

4)             Write the Truth Table of a 2:1 MUX and Explain the working of it using both restoring logic (Tri-   (4)  
  State) and non-restoring logic (TG-based).  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
  B)   Explain the Advantages and Disadvantages of different layout styles shown below. In Which Specific             (4)  
  Scenario should we use the layout style as in Figure (a)  
  Figure (a) is Separated Diffusion connected by Metal and contacts.  
  Figure (b) is Shared Contacted Diffusion  
  Figure (c) is Non-Contacted shared diffusion.  
  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  C)        Explain the Advantages and Disadvantages of different layout styles shown below. What will be the (2)  
  effective Width and Length of the below circuits.  
  $$NMOS1 - W=2µm, L=100nm$$  
  $$NMOS2 - W=4µm, L=100nm$$  
  $$NMOS3 - W=6µm, L=100nm$$  
  Wparallel = ? Lparallel = ?  
  Wseries = ? Lserie s = ?  
  
  
  Page #3

Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
5)                       Explain the phenomenon of Electro-migration. What layout and routing techniques can reduce           (4)  
  electro-migration risk in VLSI design?  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
  B)               Explain Latch-up in detail using a cross-section diagram of a CMOS inverter. Show the parasitic      (4)  
  devices that are formed in the cross-section.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
  C)               Explain the working of a 6-T memory cell.                                                            (2)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"
